Design is ready. Read DECISIONS.md first and answer the `needs you` rows. Then read IMPL-PLAN.md. To start the build, change the first line of IMPL-PLAN.md to `Status: APPROVED by <your name> <date>`. I will not write code before that.

**Things to know before you read:**

- **The skill path was broken.** `.claude/skills/design-agent` is a symlink to `scratchpad/design-agent`, which doesn't exist. I used the kit's source copy at `outputs/newsletters/2026-11-20-tinyfish-shuhao/kit/design-agent/SKILL.md` instead. Fix the link if you want the repo to be self-contained.
- **The repo is an empty template.** It has no dashboard, users, email provider or stack. Every file path in ENG-PLAN.md is proposed and assumes Python. DECISIONS #11 asks you to confirm the stack or point me at the real repo.
- **I didn't run the experiment.** There is no product, data or email access here. `experiment/README.md` describes a 3-week concierge digest sent by hand to 10–20 users. The success metrics in PRD.md are unsourced placeholders.
- **Mixpanel is unverified.** My search found no native scheduled email report for it. The other four products in the market table (Looker Studio, Metabase, Amplitude, Tableau) are sourced.

**Decisions:** 11 need you and 4 are decided by the agent. The big ones are what "export" means (I read it as a scheduled subscription) and who can receive the email (I assumed owner only). The rest are what data may leave the product, the email provider and sender domain, opt-in vs default-on, the schema migration, and the unsubscribe token.

**Plan:** IMPL-PLAN.md has six milestones, about 24 agent hours, and rolls out behind a flag starting at 1%. Most milestones are high risk and need a human owner on the PR.

Files are in `docs/features/weekly-email-digest/` on branch `design/weekly-email-digest`: PRD.md, ENG-PLAN.md, IMPL-PLAN.md, DECISIONS.md and `experiment/README.md`. IMPL-PLAN.md still starts with `Status: DRAFT - awaiting human approval`, and I touched nothing under `app/`, `infra/` or `tests/`. Nothing is committed.
